entities.summary: Shigeyoshi Inoue  was an admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. He was commander of the Japanese 4th Fleet and later served as Vice-Minister of the Navy. A noted naval theorist, he was a strong advocate of naval aviation within the Japanese Navy. General Nobuyuki Abe was his brother-in-law.
